tools.name: create_group_calendar
tools.description: Use this when someone wants a shared calendar that a group subscribes to: a team practice schedule, class timetable, club or family events. Publishes a page with the upcoming events and subscribe links (webcal, Google Calendar add-by-URL) to a live iCalendar feed. Takes 1-200 events in one IANA time

tools.name: show_group_calendar
tools.description: Use this when the organizer wants to see a group calendar they made: its events with their numbers, the next dates and the subscribe links. Needs the private organizer link (contains /m/). Does not change the calendar.

tools.name: update_group_calendar
tools.description: Use this when the organizer wants to add events to a group calendar, change an event (time, date, place, note, repeat, skipped dates), cancel or restore an event, or rename the calendar.
